protocol: Slide-seqV2 RCTD singlets, 1893 beads, 3-fold OOF, 3 seeds, paired t-test vs hard-label scLDL

v1_soft_targets_gce.note: Global 55% graph mix + GCE + manifold. Rejected.

v2_agreement_weights_hard_targets.note: Hard one-hots, downweight neighbor disagreement, lightly smooth Y_ref. Best of the three; still not a large win.

v3_adaptive_per_cell_mix.note: Mix toward graph only when neighbors disagree. Hurt clean and similar-type noise.

decision: Do not change the default type trainer. label_smooth='on' keeps the v2 weight-only recipe as an opt-in. None of the recipes produced a large, general robustness gain.
